name: Honorable Champion
body:
You draw strength from adhering to an honor code in combat.

Benefit(s): Once per day, if an effect would compel you to harm an ally, abandon an ally, or break your word, you can attempt a Will save at the usual DC to end the effect. If the effect normally allows a Will save at this point, you can roll twice and take the better result.
